Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1316.jpg'}
{3: "From a tucked-away storage room, the faint sound of crying reached Gunnar's ears."}
{1: '1', 3: 'He paused and waited patiently, and before long, Lumi stepped through the doorway.'}
{3: 'She lowered her head, only to lift it again a heartbeat later, her words spilling out in a breathless stream.'}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: "Sir, the critical patient we had in your quarters... just... he didn't make it...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: "And... with the rioters gone, there's... there's a lot of empty rooms now... So all the wounded, they can each have their own space to rest.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Lumi's eyes were red-rimmed, and her words tumbled out in a messy, disjointed rush."}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: "What I mean is... your room's free tonight, sir. You can have it back.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'I... Are you alright, Lumi?', 4: '2'}
{3: "Captain Gunnar caught the deepening red in Lumi's eyes, but she only gave a thick, shaky breath and refused to let the tears fall."}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: "Sieg... Sieg's gone. I was working on the others, and I just... I turned my back for a second. Now I don't even know where they took his body...", 4: '1'}
{3: "It was the riot. Gunnar did not press further, unwilling to tear open the girl's fresh wound."}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: "We came here together... Commander Gunner, two more years and we would've graduated... I don't... when we go back, I don't know how I'm...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Gunnar exhaled a deep sigh and stroked her hair gently.'}
{3: 'In the end, Lumi kept the tears from falling.'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Those we lose at sea... we have our own way of seeing them off.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "We'll give him a proper goodbye. You have my word.", 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory601.jpg'}
{3: 'Dock 2, normally reserved for supply ships, had become a waystation for the fallen. Its empty cargo apron now held the dead.'}
{3: "Gunnar came in through the rear entrance, alone. A gas mask covered his face, worn only at Lumi's insistence."}
{3: "Sieg's body rested in the last row near the back door, his youthful face still smeared with blood."}
{3: 'The body bag was not yet fully closed. His once-crisp uniform was dark with stains, the stiff collar crumpled and undone.'}
{3: 'Gunnar moved from body to body, pressing his hand to his heart in salute. Every one of them had been his soldier, his comrade.'}
{3: "When he reached the row just before Sieg's, a bitter smile tugged at his lips."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: '...Sander, my old friend.', 4: '1'}

{3: "There lay the body of the detachment's deputy captain, with cold moonlight spilling across his lifeless face. This old friend, who had followed Gunnar for so many years, had fallen during yesterday's rescue mission."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'How did he...', 4: '1'}
{3: "Sander's body rested quietly beneath the moon, dressed only in his blood-soaked uniform. There was no other cover, no shroud, nothing more."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "We're even short on body bags now...?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He pressed his eyes closed and swallowed the burning tears.'}
{3: 'A biting winter wind sliced through the dock, cold as a missive from Helheim, as if the death goddess Hel herself was tallying her faithful among the fallen.'}

{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Don't get turned around on the way. That ferry to Helheim isn't for you... You died with your heads up, as true warriors. We'll see each other again in the golden hall.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Gunnar slipped off his coat and laid it gently over Sander's body."}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Must be cold out here.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The winter sea wind stole the warmth from every tear before it could leave his eyes, freezing his sorrow into something hard and heavy in his chest.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory210.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory210.png'}
{3: 'He ought to have gone back to his room and slept. But he pulled a container into place and sat down where he could watch over the dead and the sea.'}
{3: 'On the eve of the coming storm, the cloud cover briefly broke, and a patch of sky peered through.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Moon's getting full...", 4: '18'}
{3: 'The moon was only chipped at the edge.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_52.jpg'}
{3: 'Gunnar sat there through the night, and as the hours crept toward dawn, more figures gathered around him.'}
{3: "Before first light, they would give the souls of those claimed by the sea back to the world. An old mariner's funeral rite."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1615.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1615.jpg'}
{3: 'Lumi had turned her jacket inside out so the bloodstains were hidden. She looked, once again, like the young, school-fresh cadet who had first arrived at the base.'}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: "Your collar's a mess... They didn't even... Let me fix this.", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: "Her voice broke as she spoke. She reached out with the cuff of her sleeve and carefully wiped the dried blood from Sieg's face, then straightened his rumpled uniform."}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: "Not that anyone's going to write you up for it now.", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'No tears, Lumi.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "Lumi, you can't let the tears fall on the face of the departed...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "If tears fall on the dead, they will carry all that grief and longing with them... They will lose their way to the sea's rest.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "Lumi, don't cry.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'They had never met before arriving at Rainbow Bridge. But here, they were a tiny piece of F.O.S., a living emblem of their academy, bound closer than anyone else.'}
{3: 'They were young. A bond so small was more than enough.'}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: "I'm not crying. I'm not going to cry...", 4: '2'}
{3: 'The soldier in her insisted she must stay strong, yet the person inside her clawed at every memory she had, desperate to barter them for relief from this sorrow.'}
{3: 'The tears broke through despite her efforts.'}
{3: 'A hand extended, capturing the drop.'}
{3: 'Moonlight turned it to a pearl, and its gleam was reflected in a pair of golden eyes.'}
{3: 'Cordelia stopped the tear before it could land, the one that would have kept the dead from their final rest.'}
{1: '1', 3: "Lumi turned and buried her face in Cordelia's shoulder, the tiny baby caught between the two young women as warm tears dripped onto her face."}
{3: 'Those tears shone like pearls under the moon, colored like its light, filled with the bitterness of sorrow.'}
{3: "Gunnar did not rush them. He stood by until the two finally drew apart and the dried tracks of Lumi's tears became nothing more than crooked little smears on Cordelia's shoulder."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Wipe your eyes, Lumi. Everyone... it's time.", 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Gunnar turned and faced the people who had assembled before him.'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Some of you are soldiers, some civilians. Some came across the sea looking for refuge, some took up arms in the riot, and some tried to leave.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Whatever your past, whatever you have done, you are all here now, at the harbor, before dawn breaks. That tells me one thing: you remember the old ways. You belong to the sea.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'The past is past. Tomorrow is not yet ours. Tonight, we have gathered for one purpose, and one alone: to send these souls on their journey.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'I ask only this. Hold your grief through the rite. Let them depart in peace.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: 'Will they hear us...? If I cry, will Sieg... hear me...?', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'He will, Lumi. In fact, he already has.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Death is not a single instant. The senses leave us one by one, and hearing lingers longest of all. It is the last door to close.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Whether their road leads to Helheim or to Valhalla, do not let your weeping disturb the hearts of the dead. Do not burden their steps with your longing. They have carried enough.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'They are gone. Now let us sing the song of farewell. Let us send them forward with blessing, with peace.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Come.', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_52.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_52.jpg'}
{3: 'Gunnar stepped back, clearing more room for the fallen.'}
{3: 'The act itself meant little in a practical sense, as the dead lay motionless in the biting winter wind and no longer needed any space at all.'}
{3: 'But Cordelia stepped back as well, recognizing the gesture as a sign of respect.'}
{3: 'With that single step, a line was drawn between the living and the dead. The realm of the departed was now set apart on the other side, sacred ground that could not be crossed.'}
{3: 'Soon, every person at the dock had taken one step back.'}
{3: "A single note rolled up from deep in Gunnar's throat, and his low, resonant voice opened the gates of the rite. Another note rose, and another."}
{3: 'The notes weaved into a melody that drifted through the gathered mourners, circling before the winter wind bore it toward the dead and out across the water.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1615.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'This is the part where you give us a verse, Mr. Poet.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Larsen froze, caught off guard.'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "...I can't think of anything.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Cordelia did not glance his way. Her eyes were fixed on the sea, where drifting boards bore small, flickering points of light.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Then just remember this. The words will come in the future.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Larsen lowered his head.'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "In the future... will it matter anymore? Does any of this matter... when I can't even do anything?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "It matters that someone saw it. That someone wrote it down. No matter how small you feel, you're here as a witness, and that's not nothing.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Ms. Erhorn.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'In the future... what do you hope this child grows up to be?', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Cordelia looked down at the baby cradled against her. Her eyes were beautifully round and perfectly shaped, but the hollowness within made them seem distant and oddly expressionless.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Well, she's been claimed by an Erhorn. That's a title with certain expectations.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'A smile tugged at the corners of her lips.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'The best thing she could be is a complete little tyrant. No rules, no leash. Does whatever she wants and dares anyone to stop her.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The little girl in her arms suddenly scrunched her face up tight. One tiny fist waved through the air, and Cordelia laughed softly, gently catching it in her own hand.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Hahaha...', 4: '1'}
{3: "The baby chomped down on Cordelia's teasing finger."}
{3: "Cordelia's eyes went gentle without her ever meaning them to."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "That's a strong bite. We might have a little firecracker on our hands.", 4: '1'}
{3: "She lowered her face and touched her forehead to the little girl's."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'A pretty face is just wrapping. Talent is a walking stick. Nice to have, but not what gets you up the mountain.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "If I could give you anything, I'd give you courage that never wavers and a soul that shines bright.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "All those things people chase, meaning and worth and purpose... they're like a puppy's tail. Run forward as hard as you can, and they'll follow right behind you.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "I'll remember this. I'll be your witness.", 4: '2'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_52.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_52.jpg'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Ms. Erhorn... can we really make it?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'How long can we last out here on the sea?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Just... one moment longer than the last. That's all. Just one moment longer.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'I thought you said will was no magic.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "I'm just a fool. What do I know?", 4: '1'}
{3: "The little potted plant on Cordelia's shoulder gave a brief pulse of light. Its recorder blinked on, then off."}
{3: 'The words were tucked away in a small, sturdy memory unit, heavy and quiet, like a seed waiting beneath the soil.'}

{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_51.jpg'}
{1: 'The Southern Node', 2: 'Present'}
{2: 'Present\\nThe Southern Node'}
{3: 'The cable-laying crew comes aboard Fenrir to change the repeaters, check the protocol coverage, and lay the fallen to rest.'}
{3: 'The sea takes everything in silence. The slow churning red thins like diluted blood, fading without a sound, until it becomes a lingering toxin that shadows these waters.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_54.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_54.jpg'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Tonight, we have gathered for one purpose, and one alone: to send these souls on their journey.'}

{2: 'Larsen', 3: '"But all the waters of the world find one another again, and the Arctic seas and the Nile gather together in the moist flight of clouds." ...Every road leads us back to each other. We are never truly apart.'}
{3: "Moonlight sheathes the side of Karenina's face in a pearlescent sheen."}

{3: 'Mara rests still on the float board, so light that it rides the swells like a single frail leaf. Karenina places a candle lantern beside her hand and touches her cold cheek with the tips of her fingers.'}
{3: 'The flame shivers alone in the sea wind.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '...Is she cold out here?'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Death takes every sense away. But someone once told me... hearing holds on the longest. It is the last thing to leave us.'}

{2: 'Larsen', 3: "That's why we don't cry when we sing the farewell song. No tears on their faces. No weight of our grief for them to carry. We let them go unburdened, so they can find their rest in the sea."}
{3: 'Karenina closes her eyes and forces down the bitterness that climbs into her throat.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'The farewell song...'}
{3: 'All the days left behind. All the faces no longer here. Only the moonlight remains the same, and the sound of the sea, and the tears.'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "When we give the sea's children back to the water, we sing. We remind each other... do not mourn, because we are never truly apart."}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'It has been years since I last sang it...'}
{3: 'But this melody, the one that has echoed through his dreams too many times to count, never fades from memory, no matter how much time slips by.'}
{3: 'A single note rolled up from deep in his throat, and his low, resonant voice opened the gates of the rite. Another note rose, and another.'}

{3: 'He sings again, the song passed down through generations. His voice comes rough and hoarse, like a reef scoured by too many tides, like the voice of someone long gone who once sang this same melody.'}
{3: 'The sea has witnessed so many goodbyes like this, so many desperate wishes for someone to stay.'}
{3: 'Then the two members from the Engineering Force pick up the tune, humming softly.'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_50.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_50.jpg'}
{3: "The sea mist settles on Karenina's eyes, pulling a thin glint of tears to the surface."}
{2: '...', 3: '236', 4: "(Wipe away Karenina's tears)", 5: '236'}
{3: 'She bunches the fabric of her clothes in her fist and bows her head. Tiny splinters of light drop into the shadow pooling beneath her.'}
{3: 'Those tears shine like pearls under the moon, colored like its light, filled with the bitterness of sorrow.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Goodbye, Mara.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'One by one, over a dozen lanterns slip into the sea. The cable-laying crew at the southern node is lost, every last one of them. These are the only remains they could find.'}
{3: "The waves bear the boards, the boards bear the candlelight, and together they become a river of lanterns, rocking with the tide like a mother's cradling arms."}
{3: 'In their faint glow, Karenina catches sight of the carving Mara left on the wall.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory783.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: '<color=#ffffffff><size=55>How much longer can we hold out?</size></color>', 4: '80', 9: '2'}
{1: '2', 2: '<color=#000000ff><size=55>How much longer can we hold out?</size></color>', 3: '-3', 4: '77', 9: '1'}
{2: '"How much longer can we hold out?"'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1615.jpg'}
{3: 'She bends down slowly and runs her fingertips over the carved line.'}
{3: 'A slight wetness lands in your palm.'}
{3: 'She takes your hand and holds it tight.'}
{3: 'Those tears shine like pearls under the moon, colored like its light, filled with the bitterness of sorrow.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Goodbye, Mara.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'One by one, over a dozen lanterns slip into the sea. The cable-laying crew at the southern node is lost, every last one of them. These are the only remains they could find.'}
{3: "The waves bear the boards, the boards bear the candlelight, and together they become a river of lanterns, rocking with the tide like a mother's cradling arms."}
{3: 'In their faint glow, Karenina catches sight of the carving Mara left on the wall.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory783.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: '<color=#ffffffff><size=55>How much longer can we hold out?</size></color>', 4: '80', 9: '2'}
{1: '2', 2: '<color=#000000ff><size=55>How much longer can we hold out?</size></color>', 3: '-3', 4: '77', 9: '1'}
{2: '"How much longer can we hold out?"'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1615.jpg'}
{3: "Karenina's hand tightens around yours in a firm, deliberate grip. It holds a solemn weight."}
{3: 'Then she slowly lets go, leans down, and runs her fingertips along the carved words.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '"How much longer can we hold out..."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'She held on until I got there...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She was holding on through every moment with a body grown frail and old.'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: 'The last. Just... one moment longer than the last.', 4: '1'}
{3: "A jumble of expressions flickers over Rarana's virtual display."}
{1: '1', 3: "Rarana floats up and nuzzles against Karenina's cheek. Inside its biosphere, the plant sways with a desperate urgency, like something aching to be said."}
{3: 'Karenina simply pulls it closer, embracing a past that is hers but that she has never truly known.'}
{3: 'The moonlight, unchanged across the years, settles on the stone walls that time barely alters. There, Karenina carves a fresh line.'}
{1: '1', 2: '<color=#ffffffff><size=55>How much longer can we hold out...</size></color>', 4: '80', 9: '2', 11: '1'}
{1: '2', 2: '<color=#000000ff><size=55>How much longer can we hold out...</size></color>', 3: '-3', 4: '77', 9: '1', 11: '1'}
{2: '"How much longer can we hold out..."'}
{1: '3', 2: '<color=#ffffffff><size=55>Just one moment longer than the last.</size></color>', 4: '-50', 9: '2', 11: '1'}
{1: '4', 2: '<color=#000000ff><size=55>Just one moment longer than the last.</size></color>', 3: '-3', 4: '-53', 9: '1', 11: '1'}
{2: '"Just one moment longer than the last."'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Just one moment longer than the last. Just one moment longer...', 4: '1'}

{3: 'The lanterns carrying the honored dead drift onward, borne by a melody both solemn and airy. They journey so far that they turn into a lone glimmer on the horizon, a glimmer that stays and stays until everyone believes it will remain forever.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_51.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_51.jpg'}
{3: 'Finally, a wave crests and lifts them high, and the lights rise as if heaven-bound, slowly, so slowly, blending back into the stars.'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Free souls, do not dissolve into the foam. Rise up from the sea and become the stars above us...'}
{3: 'The sea dims at last, and the ocean takes her children back into her arms.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Let's go. Back to our route."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "We're taking our ocean back."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1624.jpg'}
{3: 'Before the first light comes, the ocean yawns like a lightless void, vaster and more profound in its darkness than the night sky above it.'}
{2: 'Sea Chart Alert', 3: 'You have entered the designated mission area. The cable layer has reached the Jormungandr node coverage zone.'}
{3: 'Karenina keeps her eyes locked on the navigation chart. The second the announcement crackles to life, a tremor runs through her body.'}
{3: 'Just as she expects, the noise that once invaded her dreams in the dead of night arrives right on schedule. Every instrument aboard the cable layer remains blind to its presence.'}
{3: "It's like a key made for Karenina alone, locking away the dark images that sleep in the deepest reaches of her M.I.N.D."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '(Whale calls... noise...)', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1449.jpg'}

{1: '1', 3: "You walk into the captain's cabin. The navigation chart glows a soft blue, its light mirrored in Karenina's eyes. She knits her brow, presses her fingers to her forehead, then lifts her face toward you."}
{2: 'Still not feeling well?', 3: '352'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Karenina tosses Rarana toward you.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Tch. What, you think I'm some fragile little flower in a biosphere? Please.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She shoves the noise down and buries it deep inside.'}
{3: 'In your palm, Rarana wiggles its tiny "feet" with perfect innocence.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Hey! Don't you roll over and show your belly to other people!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Karenina lets out a yell and snatches Rarana right back.'}
{3: 'She seems to have pulled herself out of her grief, her frame showing no sign of strain. This is the same spirited Karenina as always, and it eases your mind, at least for the moment.'}
{3: 'On the other side of the room, a member of the cable-laying crew presses a hand to his temple with a grimace.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: "I'll cycle through a few more channels.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'All the comm channels offer nothing but a wash of static, like seawater trapped in your ears, smudging everything into obscurity.'}
{3: 'The one with the long name groans, collapses onto the desk, and begins rolling his face across it. Without a word, Larsen shifts the poetry book to a safer spot.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Captain, we've been exiled.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Still nothing back?', 3: '386'}
{3: 'Karenina shakes her head. With communications still crippled, any hope of a timely reply from Babylonia feels like a distant dream.'}

{3: 'Your gaze drifts back to the data screen in your hands. The display still shows the same information from several minutes ago, a report compiled by the cable-laying team and ready for submission to the Science Council.'}
{3: 'It contains the intelligence on the buffer pool, decoded by Mara at the cost of her life.'}

{3: 'From Karenina\'s account, you can already piece together the truth. That "black hole" in Arius\' grasp, the one that devours all information and data, is almost certainly the half of the Understanding Sefirah that he took.'}
{2: "He hasn't mastered the half-Sefirah's power yet.", 3: '397'}
{2: 'He needs a massive data feed, enough to wake it up and keep it stable.', 3: '398'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "So that's the play? Sabotage the whole oceanic fiber-optic network, force Babylonia into a panic, and rush out the second-gen repeaters. As for the repeaters... someone planted the trap way back during first-gen R&D.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "After that calamity all those years ago, who ended up with Arius Erhorn's holdings?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The group exchanges uncertain looks. Larsen lowers his gaze.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 4: '4'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory00.png'}
